title: Xtream Codes vs M3U: How to Add Your IPTV Playlist on Android TV (2026)
excerpt: Xtream Codes or M3U? What each format is, how to pull your Xtream login out of an M3U link, how to add it on Android TV and Fire TV, and how to fix common errors.
content:
*This guide uses 4Klive, the IPTV player developed by the RabbitAI TV team, for the step-by-step part. The explanations about Xtream Codes and M3U apply to any player.*

When you sign up with an IPTV provider, you usually receive your access in one of two formats: **Xtream Codes** details or an **M3U link**. They often point to the same account, but they don't work the same way in your player. This guide explains the difference, shows how to turn one into the other, and walks you through adding your playlist on an Android TV or Fire TV with 4Klive.

## What is Xtream Codes?

Xtream Codes is a **login format**. Instead of a single link, you get four pieces of information:

- **Host:** the server address, for example *tv.example.com*;
- **Port:** a number such as 80 or 8080;
- **Username**;
- **Password**.

With these, the player talks to your provider's server and asks for exactly what it needs:

- the channel categories;
- the TV guide, loaded automatically;
- movies and series in separate sections, with posters and descriptions;
- catch-up on channels that support it;
- your account status, such as expired or too many connections.

That's why players built for TV, like 4Klive and TiviMate, work best with Xtream Codes.

## What is an M3U playlist?

An M3U is a **plain list of streams**. Each entry has a channel name, often a logo and a group, followed by the stream address. You receive it as a link or a file.

M3U is universal, and almost every player can open one. But it's just a list:

- the TV guide must be added separately (an "EPG" or XMLTV link);
- movies and series are mixed into long lists;
- very large playlists can be slow to load.

## Xtream Codes vs M3U at a glance

| Feature | Xtream Codes | M3U |
|---|---|---|
| What you get | Host, port, username, password | One link or file |
| TV guide (EPG) | Loaded automatically | Separate EPG link needed |
| Movies and series | Organized sections with details | Mixed into the list |
| Catch-up | Supported when the provider offers it | Rarely |
| Account status | Shown by the player | Not available |
| Works in 4Klive | Yes | Only links generated by an Xtream server |

**Bottom line:** if your provider offers Xtream Codes, use it.

## How to turn an M3U link into Xtream Codes details

Most providers generate their M3U link from an Xtream server. In that case, **your Xtream details are already inside the link**. Look for *get.php?username=* in it.

![An M3U link broken down into its host, port, username and password](/images/blog/4klive/m3u-to-xtream.jpg)

1. **Host:** the part after *http://* or *https://* and before the colon, for example *tv.example.com*.
2. **Port:** the number after the colon, for example 8080. If there's no number, it's 80 for links starting with *http://* and 443 for *https://*.
3. **Username:** the value after *username=*.
4. **Password:** the value after *password=*, up to the next *&*.

If the link starts with **https://**, also tick **HTTPS** when you add the playlist.

If your link doesn't contain *get.php?username=* (for example a file ending in *.m3u* on a file-sharing site), it's a standalone M3U file. You'll need a player that accepts plain M3U, such as IPTV Smarters Pro, UHF or TiviMate.

## How to add your playlist in 4Klive (Android TV and Fire TV)

If 4Klive isn't installed yet, follow our [Firestick installation guide](/blog/how-to-install-iptv-firestick) first. On first launch, the TV shows a **TV code** and a **PIN**.

### Option 1: from your phone (recommended)

1. Scan the QR code on the TV, or open **rabbitaitv.com/activate**.
2. Enter the TV code and PIN, then select **Continue**.
3. Select **Add a playlist** and give it a name (for example "Home").
4. Keep the **Xtream Codes** tab and fill in **Host**, **Port**, **Username** and **Password**.
5. Tick **My provider uses HTTPS** only if your link starts with *https://*.
6. Save. Keep 4Klive open: the TV picks up the playlist within a few seconds.

![The rabbitaitv.com/activate page on a phone](/images/blog/4klive/4klive-activate-phone.jpg)

You can add **up to 20 playlists** to the same TV, for example one per provider or per family member. Switch between them on the TV under **Settings > Playlists**.

### Option 2: with the remote

On the activation screen, select **Manual entry**. Fill in Host, Port, Username and Password, choose **HTTP** or **HTTPS**, then select **Connect**.

![4Klive manual entry screen with Host, Port, Username and Password fields](/images/blog/4klive/4klive-manual-entry.jpg)

The **Use M3U URL** option on this screen is for M3U links generated by an Xtream server. Standalone M3U files aren't supported yet.

## Two settings worth knowing

Once your playlist is loaded, open **Settings** in 4Klive:

- **Live stream format.** HLS (.m3u8) is more resilient. MPEG-TS (.ts) can switch channels faster with some providers. If a channel stutters, try the other one.
- **Buffer size.** A larger buffer reduces stalls on weak connections, but channels take a little longer to start. Leave it on **Auto** unless you have problems.

![4Klive live TV with the programme guide filled in automatically](/images/blog/4klive/4klive-live-tv.jpg)

## Error messages and how to fix them

### "Credentials rejected by the IPTV server"

The TV received your playlist, but the server refused the login. On rabbitaitv.com/activate, check the host, port, username and password: they are case-sensitive and must not contain spaces. Also check HTTP vs HTTPS.

### "Sign-in failed: invalid username or password"

Same cause: the username or password is wrong. Copy them again from your provider's email rather than retyping them.

### "Subscription expired"

The player works, but your provider account has ended. Contact your provider to renew it.

### "Account unavailable"

Your provider has disabled the account. Only the provider can reactivate it.

### "Too many connections"

Your account allows a limited number of simultaneous streams, and another device is already watching. Stop the stream on the other device, then try again.

### "No connection" or "Server unreachable"

Either your internet connection or your provider's server is down. Test another app on the TV. If everything else works, wait a few minutes, then contact your provider.

## Keep your login safe

- Don't share your Xtream details or M3U link publicly. Anyone who has them can use your connections.
- In 4Klive, playlist details are stored encrypted and only used by your TV. Adding or editing a playlist requires the TV's PIN.
- If you think someone has your TV's PIN, change it under **Settings > Playlists > Change TV PIN**.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Xtream Codes better than M3U?

For watching on a TV, yes. You get an automatic TV guide, organized movies and series, catch-up and clear error messages. M3U is mainly useful with players that don't support Xtream Codes.

### Can I use a standalone M3U file with 4Klive?

Not yet. 4Klive accepts Xtream Codes details and M3U links generated by an Xtream server (with *get.php?username=* in them). For a plain M3U file, use a player that accepts M3U, such as IPTV Smarters Pro, UHF or TiviMate.

### Where do I find my Xtream Codes details?

In the welcome email or customer area of your provider. If you only received an M3U link, extract the four values as shown above.

### Why is the TV guide empty for some channels?

The guide comes from your provider. If a channel has no guide data on their side, no player can show it. With Xtream Codes, the guide loads automatically for every channel that has one.

### Is Xtream Codes legal?

Xtream Codes is a technical login format, and using it is perfectly legal. What matters is the content: only use providers that have the rights to the channels they distribute.

### Which IPTV players support Xtream Codes?

Almost all of them, including 4Klive, TiviMate, OTT Navigator, IPTV Smarters Pro, UHF and IPTVX. See our [comparison of the best IPTV apps](/blog/best-iptv-apps-2026).

- **Closest feature match (recording, multi-view):** OTT Navigator

## 2. OTT Navigator: the closest match to TiviMate's features

OTT Navigator is the alternative for people who love TiviMate's depth. It runs on Android phones, Android TV and Fire TV, and supports:

- Xtream Codes, M3U and Stalker playlists;
- catch-up, timeshift, recording, picture-in-picture and multi-view;
- a customizable interface with several skins.

**Price.** Free with ads and some limits. An optional Premium tier unlocks the rest, with monthly and lifetime options that vary by region.

**Limitations.** It's Android-only, like TiviMate, and its menus are even more technical. Expect to spend time in the settings.

**Who it's for:** experienced users who want recording and multi-view and don't mind tweaking.

## 3. IPTV Smarters Pro: the free alternative on almost every device

IPTV Smarters Pro is free and exists on Android, Fire TV, iPhone, iPad and computers. It handles both Xtream Codes and M3U playlists.

**Limitations.** The interface is dated and built for touchscreens, so it's slower to use with a TV remote. Store availability also changes by region. On Fire TV it is often sideloaded, so make sure you install the official app.

**Who it's for:** people who want one free app on every screen and don't need advanced features.

## 4. UHF: the best TiviMate alternative on Apple TV

TiviMate doesn't exist on Apple devices. UHF is the closest equivalent there. It runs on Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Macs, and supports:

- M3U and Xtream Codes, plus Plex, Jellyfin and Emby;
- a TV guide and catch-up;
- 4K HDR, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos.

**Price.** Free to start. Pro costs $1.99 per month, $17.99 per year or $49.99 lifetime (US App Store).

**Who it's for:** Apple TV owners who want a full-featured player.

## 5. IBO Player Pro: the alternative for Samsung and LG TVs

TiviMate can't be installed on Samsung (Tizen) or LG (webOS) TVs. IBO Player Pro is available in those TVs' app stores.

**Price.** After a 7-day trial you activate each device, for roughly €6 per year or €14 for lifetime (prices vary by reseller).

**Limitations.** The interface is basic.

**Who it's for:** smart TV owners who don't want an extra device. If you're open to plugging something in, a Fire TV Stick 4K gives you access to 4Klive, TiviMate and OTT Navigator.

## Is "TiviMate 8K" or "TiviMate Pro APK" real?

No. The official app is **TiviMate IPTV Player** by Armobsoft. You get it from the Google Play Store on Android TV, or from **tivimate.com** for sideloading on Fire TV. Its Premium features are unlocked through the official purchase.

APKs called "TiviMate 8K", "TiviMate Pro" or "TiviMate Premium unlocked" on download sites are **modified copies**. They can contain malware, they break with official updates, and they aren't authorized by the developer. If you want TiviMate, install the real one with our [TiviMate installation guide](/blog/install-tivimate-iptv-player-firestick-android-tv). If you want something free, OTT Navigator or IPTV Smarters Pro are legitimate options.

## How to switch from TiviMate to 4Klive

1. Find your provider's **Xtream Codes** details (host, port, username, password). They're in the email your provider sent you, or in your current player's playlist settings.
2. Install 4Klive with Downloader code **9234307** ([step-by-step guide](/blog/how-to-install-iptv-firestick)).
3. Open 4Klive, scan the QR code with your phone and add the same Xtream details. The TV connects by itself.
4. Keep TiviMate installed during the 7-day trial so you can compare both side by side.

Favorites and watch history don't transfer between apps, so expect to re-add your favorite channels.

![4Klive channel list open over a live channel](/images/blog/4klive/4klive-live-overlay.jpg)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the best free alternative to TiviMate?

OTT Navigator is the closest free alternative on Android and Fire TV, with recording and multi-view. IPTV Smarters Pro is free on more devices but has fewer features. 4Klive is free for 7 days, then $9.99 per year or $24.99 for lifetime.

### Does TiviMate work on the Fire TV Stick 4K Select?

No. The Fire TV Stick 4K Select runs Vega OS, which can't install apps from outside the Amazon Appstore. The same applies to 4Klive and OTT Navigator. Use a Fire TV Stick 4K, 4K Max or Fire TV Cube instead.

### What's the best TiviMate alternative for Apple TV?

UHF is the most complete. IPTVX is the most polished but costs more. See our [comparison of the best IPTV apps](/blog/best-iptv-apps-2026) for details.

### Can I use my TiviMate playlist in another app?

Yes. The playlist belongs to your provider, not to TiviMate. Enter the same Xtream Codes details (or M3U link, for apps that accept it) in the new player.

### Is TiviMate still worth it in 2026?

Yes, if you use recording or multi-view, or want one purchase for up to 5 devices. If you mainly want live TV and a simple guide on one TV, a simpler app like 4Klive is easier to live with.

In 2025, Amazon started shipping some Fire TV sticks with **Vega OS** instead of Fire OS. Vega OS **cannot install apps from outside the Amazon Appstore**, so Downloader and 4Klive won't work on it.

To check, go to **Settings > My Fire TV > About** and look at the software version:

- **"Fire OS" followed by a number:** you're good, continue with this guide.
- **"OS 1." something:** your device runs Vega OS. Today that's the **Fire TV Stick 4K Select** and the **2nd-generation Fire TV Stick HD**.

Fire TV Stick 4K, Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Fire TV Cube and TVs with Fire TV built-in run Fire OS and work fine. If your stick runs Vega OS, use an Android TV or Google TV device instead (see the end of this guide).

2. Select the orange Downloader app by AFTVnews and choose **Get** or **Download**.
3. Open it once, and allow access to files if it asks.

## Step 2: Allow Downloader to install apps

Fire TV hides the developer settings by default, so you have to unlock them first.

1. Go to **Settings > My Fire TV > About**.
2. Highlight your device name (for example "Fire TV Stick 4K") and press the select button on the remote **7 times**. A message says you are now a developer.
3. Go back to **Settings > My Fire TV > Developer options**.
4. Open **Install unknown apps** and turn **Downloader** to **ON**.

Only Downloader needs this permission. Leave it off for every other app.

On first launch, 4Klive shows a **TV code**, a **PIN** and a QR code.

1. **Scan the QR code** with your phone's camera, or open **rabbitaitv.com/activate** in any browser. With the QR code, the TV code is filled in for you.

**Prefer the remote?** Select **Manual entry** on the TV and type your Xtream Codes details there instead.

**About M3U links:** 4Klive works with Xtream Codes accounts. An M3U link generated by an Xtream server (a link containing *get.php?username=*) works too. Standalone M3U files aren't supported yet. More in our guide [Xtream Codes vs M3U](/blog/xtream-codes-vs-m3u-android-tv).

## Put 4Klive on your home screen

Sideloaded apps land at the end of your app list. To keep 4Klive close:

1. Press and hold the **Home** button, then select **Apps**.
2. Highlight 4Klive and press the **Options** button (three lines).
3. Choose **Move to front**.

### Downloader says the code is invalid or nothing happens

Type the full address **rabbitaitv.com/downloads/4klive.apk** in the address box and press **Go**. Also check that your Fire TV is connected to the internet.

### "App not installed"

This usually means there's not enough free storage, or an older test version of 4Klive is already installed. Delete the old version under **Settings > Applications > Manage installed applications**, free up some space, and try again.

### The TV says "Can't reach the server — retrying…"

The TV isn't reaching the internet. Check your Wi-Fi and restart the Fire TV (Settings > My Fire TV > Restart). A restart also resyncs the clock, and a wrong clock blocks secure connections.

### "Credentials rejected by the IPTV server"

The playlist was received, but your provider refused the login. Open rabbitaitv.com/activate again and double-check the server address, port, username and password. They are case-sensitive.

### Streams buffer or freeze

For 4K, aim for at least 25 Mbps. Use 5 GHz Wi-Fi or an Ethernet adapter, and keep the stick away from the back of the TV. If only some channels buffer, the issue is on the provider's side, not the player.

Yes, as long as you only enable it for Downloader and only install apps from sources you trust. You can turn it off again once 4Klive is installed. Updates are installed the same way.

### Does 4Klive work on the Fire TV Stick 4K Select?

No. The Fire TV Stick 4K Select and the 2nd-generation Fire TV Stick HD run Vega OS, which can't install apps from outside the Amazon Appstore. Use a Fire TV Stick 4K, 4K Max, Fire TV Cube, or an Android TV or Google TV device.

### Is 4Klive free?

The first 7 days are free and start automatically. After that it costs $9.99 per year or $24.99 for a lifetime licence. Your channels come from your own provider and are billed separately.

### Can I use 4Klive on several TVs?

Yes, but each TV needs its own licence. If you replace or factory-reset a TV, it needs a new one.
